title: PROPOSED additions to media_buy.features; not published

supports_collection_selection.description: Opt-in native strict-subset selection and qualified sandbox fixture commitment with at least two distinct domain-qualified pairs; existing product default-readback obligations still bind.

supports_collection_default_materializat.description: Opt-in native full-bundle default materialization and qualified sandbox fixture commitment with at least one distinct domain-qualified pair; independent of strict-subset fixtures.

supports_fixed_bundle_enforcement.description: Opt-in fixed-bundle strict-subset enforcement and qualified sandbox fixture commitment with at least two distinct domain-qualified pairs; independent of one-pair restatement.

supports_fixed_bundle_restatement.description: Opt-in fixed full-bundle restatement and qualified sandbox fixture commitment with at least one distinct domain-qualified pair; independent of two-pair enforcement.

supports_cross_publisher_collection_rest.description: Opt-in full-set restatement and selector-boundary behavior for cross-publisher collections, with a qualified sandbox fixture commitment with at least one pair outside every product property publisher domain; no ownership or authorization proof.

supports_cross_publisher_collection_subs.description: Opt-in selectable cross-publisher strict-subset behavior and qualified sandbox fixture commitment with two total distinct pairs, retaining an external pair; no ownership or authorization proof.

supports_format_breakdown.description: Opt-in native format-grain reporting support and qualified sandbox fixture commitment; no required observed rows.

supports_time_based_views.description: Opt-in native time-threshold view reporting support and qualified sandbox fixture commitment; no prescribed thresholds or observations.
